title: The Spiritual Exercises of St. Ignatius of Loyola
author: Ignatius of Loyola
description: Ignatius of Loyola’s sequence of meditations and prayers guides discernment and reflection on the life of Christ in Elder Mullan’s English rendering.
editionNote: 1914 edition. New York: P.J. Kenedy & Sons. Edition credit: Elder Mullan, S.J. (1865–1925). The EPUB is a facsimile with page images.
rights: Public-domain historical edition. Source credit and notices are retained.
